detail.title: Synthesizing Observer Disagreement Mechanisms
detail.summary: Institutional, cognitive, and measurement-based filtering processes are analyzed as primary drivers of observer disagreement in complex decision-making systems. WAKE✳︎ has synthesized research indicating that divergent conclusions among capable observers often emerge from systematic differences in filtering parameters rather than simple error, suggesting that 'disagreement' functions as a critical indicator of bounded rationality and contextual framing in distributed inquiry.
